label: Small Biotech IND — Quality Overall Summary (2.3)
description: Module 2.3 Quality Overall Summary for NovaTide-1 (bispecific antibody, lyophilized formulation).

inputs.qos_s1_summary: Novatide alfa is a CD3×CD20 bispecific IgG1 antibody (MW ~145 kDa) produced in CHO-K1 cells. The molecule incorporates knobs-into-holes Fc engineering for correct heavy chain pairing.
inputs.qos_s2_summary: Drug substance is manufactured by Catalent Biologics (Madison, WI) using a fed-batch CHO process (2,000 L). Three-column purification yields >99% purity. Two viral clearance steps included.
inputs.qos_s3_summary: Structure confirmed by intact mass, peptide mapping, SEC-MALS, and IEF. Glycosylation profile characterized by HILIC-UPLC. Forced degradation studies identified aggregation as the primary degradation pathway.
inputs.qos_s4_summary: Release specification includes identity (CEX-HPLC, peptide map), potency (reporter gene bioassay), purity (SE-HPLC, CE-SDS), and process impurities (HCP, DNA, Protein A). Three clinical batches meet all specifications.
inputs.qos_s5_summary: Primary and secondary reference standards established and qualified. Certificate of analysis available.
inputs.qos_s6_summary: 50 mL Type I glass vials with FluroTec® coated stoppers. Extractables/leachables study completed; no concerns identified.
inputs.qos_s7_summary: 12-month real-time stability data support proposed 18-month retest period at -20 °C ± 5 °C. Stability-indicating methods validated.
inputs.qos_p1_summary: Drug product is a lyophilized formulation containing 50 mg novatide alfa per vial in histidine buffer with sucrose and PS80.
inputs.qos_p2_summary: Formulation optimized using DoE approach. Key attributes: rapid reconstitution (<60 s), low aggregation, acceptable cake appearance. Lyophilization cycle robustness confirmed.
inputs.qos_p3_summary: Manufactured by Baxter BioPharma Solutions (Bloomington, IN) via aseptic fill and lyophilization. Batch size: 10,000 vials. Process validated at clinical scale.
inputs.qos_p4_summary: All excipients are pharmacopeial grade (USP/NF). No novel excipients used.
inputs.qos_p5_summary: Release specification includes appearance, identity, assay, content uniformity, reconstitution time, purity, sterility, endotoxin, and particulates. All clinical batches conform.
inputs.qos_p6_summary: Same reference standards as drug substance.
inputs.qos_p7_summary: 13 mL Type I glass vials consistent with drug substance container closure. E&L assessment complete.
inputs.qos_p8_summary: 12-month data at 2–8 °C support proposed 24-month shelf life. Accelerated data confirm stability-indicating methods.
inputs.regional_info: US Regional — DMF reference: Not applicable (no DMF filed by excipient suppliers). Environmental Assessment: Categorical exclusion claimed per 21 CFR 25.31(a).
